settings.heading: Fullerene C60
settings.text: Hyperlight Optics uses patented Swiss technology with FULLERENE C60 as a quantum light transformer, converting all light into Hyperharmonized light. As light passes through the nanophotonic Fullerene filter, the fullerene twists at a near-inconceivable 18 billion times per second, altering photon orientation. The 20 hexagons in C60 exhibit the Faraday effect, while the 12 pentagons follow the Fibonacci sequence. This biocompatible Hyperharmonized light optimally energizes biostructures, promoting physiological balance.

settings.heading: Benefits
settings.text: Protect your eyes, support focus, mental performance, and everyday well-being with Hyperlight Optics®️. Experience enhanced visual clarity, sharper contrast, richer colors, reduced glare, and less eye strain during long hours of screen exposure or changing light conditions. Designed for all-day comfort, our lenses support concentration, depth perception, smoother indoor-to-outdoor transitions, and a more relaxed visual experience throughout the day and night.

settings.heading: Technology
settings.text: Hyperlight Optics are unique because of the special nanophotonic materials used in their production, which transform ordinary, diffused light into a new light that is considerably more compatible with our biomolecules. It means that a photon interacts with Fullerene C60 to form an exciton. The photon and the exciton couple together and eventually combine, to form a polariton. The energy particles of previous photons in the polariton are ordered following the laws of the electromagnetism of biomolecules, both in our eyes and in our brain. For this reason, they have an impact on the entire neuroendocrine system. This contributes to better body regulation, thus placing Hyperlight Optics as a unique, leading brand in the sunglasses and blue-light blockers market.

settings.heading: Specifications
settings.text:
1. The protective layer is on both sides of the lens.

2. Hydro and oleophobic coating: protects against scratching and facilitates cleaning and has an antistatic component that repels dust particles from both sides of the lens.

3. Patented 8 layers of ion coatings: following the Ioncoat K+ process, eight layers of material with different index levels are vacuum applied to the lenses. Ioncoat K+ reduces light reflection to less than 1%, resulting in better vision.

4. Optimizing the Hard layer (HC): specially matched with the anti-reflection process and the superhydrophobic layer, it extends the life of the anti-reflection layer and provides additional protection against scratches.;

5. Fullerene layer on both sides of the lens.

6. CR 39 lenses.

settings.heading: Dual-Layer Lens Protection System
settings.text: Following the Fullerene C60 Patented coating, the base ultra-clear lens features two protective layers on both sides: the first layer contains Anti-scratch, STC, and Hydro and oleophobic coating, while the second layer consists of Anti-reflex with 8 layers of ion coating.

settings.heading: Base ultra-clear lens
settings.text: The premium base ultra-clear lens delivers exceptional optical clarity and maximizes light transmission for crystal-clear vision.

settings.heading: Fullerene C60 Patented coating
settings.text: The revolutionary Fullerene C60 coating, applied to both sides of the base ultra-clear lens, integrates space-derived carbon molecules into Hyperlight Optics. Acting as a nanophotonic generator, it creates Hyperlight – a unique light structure that matches healthy biostructures' symmetry, helping restore natural homeostasis through resonance principles.

settings.heading: Anti-reflex, 8 layers of ion coating
settings.text: The sophisticated anti-reflective system consists of 8 precision-applied layers of ion coating, effectively eliminating unwanted light reflections and glare while maximizing light transmission for superior visual clarity.

settings.heading: Blue mirror coloring coating*
settings.text:
For outdoor models, a specialized coating creates a blue mirror effect on the lens surface, providing an attractive reflective blue finish while effectively reflecting sunlight for enhanced outdoor performance.

*only for outdoor models

settings.heading: Anti-scratch, STC, Hydro and oleophobic coating
settings.text: A comprehensive protective layer combines anti-scratch resistance, STC (Superior Top Coat), and hydro/oleophobic properties to defend against scratches while repelling water, oil, and fingerprints for easier cleaning and clearer vision.
